name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 7 visits over 75 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.6 days starting 2026-05-11, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 3.94 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
